title: Nostalgia and the AI Productivity Paradox
why_read: This is a reflective personal essay about AI changing the feel of software development; it is readable but offers no technical depth or new insight.
analysis: The article uses the arrival of GTA VI and an AI coding agent as a frame for reflecting on how software development has changed emotionally across a career. It covers the junior-to-senior progression and what made each stage fun. The argument that AI is removing the hands-on craft that made programming enjoyable is a common and recurring theme in developer discourse right now. There is nothing technically new here, and the piece does not engage with specific tools, benchmarks, or engineering trade-offs.
